text:
nina (Sales Ops): FYI SummitAI submitted a formal dispute for invoice INV-2026-0621. They claim a misattributed evaluation burst and are requesting a retroactive 25% credit on the overage plus extension to Net60 for that invoice. Tanya looped RevOps.
tanya (Account Exec): Quick context: they committed 50M tokens but April traffic sent eval jobs from a partner integration; overage = 400k tokens = $120,000. They want 25% -> $30,000 credit and payment extension to Net60 citing cashflow from customer. They're willing to sign a 3-month commit amendment if we agree.
lucas (RevOps): Uploaded the usage audit and partner integration logs to the ticket. Looks like 60% of the overage is from the partner account that should have been billed separately. Net exposure if we accept credit = $48,000 (if we also pursue partner reimbursement).
omar (Finance): Rules: Any one-off credit > $25k needs Sr Finance approval. Payment term changes > 30 days need manager-level signoff. We need the exact numbers and proposed accounting treatment. Also want to avoid stretching DSOs too often.
nina (Sales Ops): Proposed deal desk resolution: 20% one-time credit on the overage ($24,000) + temporary extension of this invoice to Net45 (not Net60). Condition: signed amendment that 1) clarifies partner billing source, 2) commits to a 3-month top-up for minimum monthly usage. This splits the difference and limits precedent.
nina (Sales Ops): Also recommending we open a recovery case against the partner for their portion (60%) separately.
iris (Legal): We can draft a short amendment and a separate partner billing acknowledgement. Need to confirm language around "one-time concession" and that Net45 is a single-invoice exception. Will prepare templates.
lucas (RevOps): Action checklist I'm tracking: 1) Finalize concession amt 2) Draft amendment and partner note 3) Create credit memo placeholder in NetSuite 4) Finance sign-off 5) Post and update invoice status. Creating ticket BILL-4629 and adding docs.
omar (Finance): I can provisionally approve up to $30k if we keep term change to Net45 and include collection plan for the partner portion. If final concession <= $30k and Net45, finance will route for posting. Anything > $30k or Net60 needs VP finance.
tanya (Account Exec): Customer verbally accepted 20% + Net45 + sign amendment. I'll get the signed amendment today and cc the partner for the billing acknowledgement.
deals-bot: Automated: Deal desk review started for thread 1776543210. Outstanding approvals: Finance confirmation, Legal amendment signed. Link: https://internal.redwood/desk/1776543210
omicros (ops-bot): Note: NetSuite credit memo template created BILL-4629-CM. Status: draft.
omar (Finance): :white_check_mark: Approving $24,000 concession and Net45 posting pending signed amendment and partner acknowledgement. Finance will post the credit in the current close once documents are attached to BILL-4629.
nina (Sales Ops): Thanks all. Closing criteria: signed amendment + partner billing acknowledgment uploaded + NetSuite credit memo posted. Tanya will drop the signed docs here.
tanya (Account Exec): Will update with signed docs by EOD. Thanks everyone.
